text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi takes the Satsuki Sho! 
An unbelievable upset against the Big 
Three!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haa, hic... haa... Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...! Aaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I did it...! I won...! I did it, I did 
it...! Me too—!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Just like the President! An "absolutely 
invincible" Umamusume——!!)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Let's calm down~, Tsurumaru-san. Now, 
breathe in~, and breathe out~..."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I've checked with the staff 
and received their permission. I'll 
administer the IV fluids now.
choice_data_list: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have the fired-up Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi sit 
down in a chair and tend to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her, the race itself isn't the only 
battle. What comes next is a fight against 
her own body.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...I wa... nt to... be in the con... 
cert... too..."
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. I know.
...Yeah. I know.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeees...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san, can you see these fingers~? 
How many am I holding up~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's 2!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like things are okay for now, 
indeed.
choice_data_list:
If it looks dangerous, step aside to the 
edge right away.

If it looks dangerous, dodge to the side 
immediately, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Don't worry! I'll be sure to sing 
right until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta show the crowd how strong 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi really is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I sent Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi 
out onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, this Winning Live will be the 
last one."
choice_data_list: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"An endless, everlasting winning the 
soul—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing at center stage, Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi basks in the full fervor directed 
at her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparks flew, cheers erupted. At the center 
of the roar, she raised a single finger—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Thank you so much for coming 
to watch today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: How could this be...!

text_block_list.name: Woman in the Audience
text_block_list.text: ...KYYYAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Stretcher! Bring a stretcher over here!!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume has gone down! The fallen 
racer is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! Wh-What did I just do in 
the middle of the concert—?!
choice_data_list:
More importantly, I'm just so glad you 
woke up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the chaos at the concert was 
skillfully smoothed over by Seiun Sky, who 
was up on stage as the MC.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There were various parties to attend to, 
but I was able to focus entirely on 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi. Praying above all else 
for her recovery..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: To think that happened...
choice_data_list:
So you really don't need to worry about 
it.

So you really don't need to worry about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. The doctor at this hospital said 
they'd like to speak with us. ...Shall we 
go hear what they have to say?
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...See you later, Tsuyoshi.
Yes. ...See you later, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, um! Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I'm not done yet!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the Derby, and then win the 
Kikuka Sho too! I'm gonna become a Triple 
Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—“Absolutely” fine, and “absolutely” 
strong! I know I can become an Umamusume 
like that!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry about this time!! Please 
guide me again starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a Triple Crown Umamusume 
together with the two of them!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: …………Tsurumaru-san.
choice_data_list:
...Yeah! Let's give it our all again 
tomorrow, Tsuyoshi!

...Yeah! Let's give it our all again 
starting tomorrow, Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter-clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. She doesn't blame us, does 
she."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Losing consciousness... and waking up in a 
hospital. Even after such a terrifying 
experience...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't scared, angry, or sad. What 
that girl worried about most of all was—
choice_data_list: ...She's just that kind of girl.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
choice_data_list: Doctor, next comes the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Japanese Derby' is 2,400 meters, 
right? That's a full 400 meters longer 
than today."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that place is the dream stage of 
every Umamusume, known to all. Without a 
doubt... it will place an even heavier 
burden on you than today did.
choice_data_list: Even so, she'll definitely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...And the basis for that?"
choice_data_list:
Because we're going to make sure she'll be 
okay.

Because we're going to make sure she's 
okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her fingernails dig into her clenched 
fists. If it's pain she herself must 
endure, she'll bear it without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she's enduring far greater pain 
than that, gritting her teeth and pushing 
forward—!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I understand your enthusiasm. I also 
understand that you are speaking with that 
factored in.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
So... please ease your hand. Her future 
needs those hands of yours.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
…………Yeah. Well, well, talk about a heavy 
responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. First, let's both go to the 
doctor at this hospital and get our 
lecture together.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
So that we, too, can fully support the 
dream of a future Triple Crown Umamusume.
